title: GoCo: structure-guided conformal calibration for error-controlled Gene Ontology annotation release
abstract: arXiv:2610.32990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computational gene-function prediction generates annotations at a scale that experimental characterization cannot match, yet substantial errors remain even among leading methods. Explicit error-controlled calibration for Gene Ontology (GO) prediction remains largely undeveloped. We introduce GoCo, a structure-guided framework that calibrates how scores from an existing predictor are converted into released annotations. GoCo certifies a global threshold for a GO-hierarchy-aware gene-level false discovery proportion (FDP), then constructs a nested release path under the same asymptotic risk-control guarantee. At the primary operating point (alpha=0.10, delta=0.50), GoCo-M, developed on Wainberg co-essentiality modules and applied without retuning to three independent studies with the same shared-evidence structure, kept mean held-out gene-level FDP at or below target while releasing 6.3-17.6% more reference-supported GO terms than Multil

translated_title: GoCo：面向错误可控的基因本体（GO）注释发布的结构引导共形校准框架
translated_abstract: 计算基因功能预测能够以实验表征无法企及的规模生成注释，然而即便在最先进的方法中仍存在大量错误。针对基因本体（GO）预测的显式错误受控校准在很大程度上仍属空白。我们提出GoCo，一种结构引导的框架，用于校准如何将现有预测器的分数转换为最终发布的注释。GoCo为感知GO层次结构的基因水平错误发现比例（FDP）认证一个全局阈值，并在相同的渐近风险控制保证下构建嵌套的发布路径。在主要操作点（α=0.10，δ=0.50）上，基于Wainberg共必需性模块开发的GoCo-M在无需重新调参的情况下被应用于三项具有相同共享证据结构的独立研究，其在保留集上的平均基因水平FDP始终保持在目标水平或以下，同时比基线方法MultiL多发布6.3%–17.6%的经参考支持的GO条目。
tldr: GoCo提出了一种结构引导的共形校准框架，通过为GO层次感知的基因水平错误发现比例（FDP）认证全局阈值并构建嵌套发布路径，在错误可控的前提下释放更多经参考支持的基因本体注释，且无需对独立数据集重新调参。
